newsitem.title: USA: ABC Dispensing gets dispensing system order.
newsitem.headline: ABC Dispensing gets dispensing system order.

text.p: ABC Dispensing Technologies Inc said it received an initial multi-million-dollar order for its new paint-tint dispensing system from Home Depot Inc.
ABC said the order is for 300 units of ABC's new automatic tinting system, tradenamed "Royal Match." Delivery is scheduled to commence in early Spring.

It said this is the initial phase of an anticipated rollout to Home Depot's entire 500-plus store network in 34 states and three Canadian provinces, with one to three units of the tinting system expected to be installed per store.
"This is the largest order to date in ABC's history," said company president Charles Stimac, Jr.
"The new relationship with The Home Depot is an important step in the validation of ABC's state-of-the-art technology."
